basic_profile.bio: I'm a 38-year-old tech enthusiast living in Austin, Texas. My passion for technology started early, and I've been working as a software engineer for over a decade. In my free time, I enjoy exploring new tech gadgets, watching obscure movies, and diving deep into internet rabbit holes. I'm a night owl, typically online from late evening until the early hours. I'm currently single and enjoy the independence that comes with it.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in Computer Science and have worked in various tech companies focusing on software development and product management. I've always been a self-learner, frequently updating my skills through online courses and tech forums.
